I'll start by looking at the workspace layout and the docs.

I'll make the edits one at a time, starting with the let-else in the core library.

Now the Makefile, which needs path remapping.

The workspace now builds with rustc 1.63 and meets the contract in `docs/BUILDING.md`. I checked each item below, and `/app/STATUS.json` says "success".

**What I fixed**
- **Compiler version:** `rust-version` in `[workspace.package]` is now `1.63`. It was `1.65`.
- **Let-else:** I replaced a let-else in `binloc-core`'s `lib.rs`, because let-else isn't available in rustc 1.63.
- **Dependencies:** `fieldsplit` 0.4.3 needed rustc 1.70, so I pinned it to 0.4.1. I ran `cargo update --offline -p fieldsplit --precise 0.4.1` against the mirror, then re-ran `cargo vendor` for `vendor/`. `checkchar` stays at 1.2.0.
- **Version:** `binloc` had a hard-coded `2.2.0`. It now uses `version.workspace = true`, and `Cargo.lock` is updated to match.
- **Features:**
  - `binloc-core` now names the `iso7064` feature it uses, so it builds on its own.
  - `binloc` names `luhn` explicitly.
  - In `main.rs`, the JSON code is now behind the `json` feature, so the scanner build compiles.
- **Tests:** `binloc`'s Cargo.toml had `autotests = false` and listed only `cli`, so `formats.rs` never ran. I removed both, and every file under `tests/` now runs.
- **Site table:** `build.rs` now reruns when `data/sites.csv` changes.
- **Reproducible builds:** the Makefile exports `RUSTFLAGS=--remap-path-prefix=$(CURDIR)=.`.

**What I ran**
- `make test` passes and runs `cli`, `formats` and `locations`. It also passes with `--no-default-features`.
- `cargo build --frozen -p binloc-core` and `cargo test --frozen -p binloc-core` pass on their own.
- The `--no-default-features` release build works, and `--format json` there prints `binloc: json output is not available in this build` with exit status 2.
- `make build COMMIT=abc123` in `/tmp/a` and `/tmp/b` gave byte-identical binaries (`cmp` matched), with no build path in them.
- Appending a site to `sites.csv` and running an incremental `make build` made it show up in `binloc sites`.
- Changing the version to 2.4.0 made `binloc --version` print `binloc 2.4.0 (commit unknown)`. I edited `Cargo.lock` to match for that test, because `--frozen` refuses a lock file that doesn't match the version.

I left the usage text alone. It lists `check`, `label`, `sites` and `--version` but not the `--help` line shown in `docs/binloc.md`, and the docs don't say whether the usage text must include it.

p='Cargo.toml'; s=open(p).read(); s=s.replace('rust-version = "1.65"','rust-version = "1.63"'); open(p,'w').write(s)

s=s.replace('autotests = false\n','')
s=s.split('\n[[test]]')[0]
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat crates/binloc/Cargo.toml crates/binloc-core/Cargo.toml

cd /app && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='crates/binloc/src/main.rs'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''#[cfg_attr(not(feature = "json"), allow(dead_code))]
enum Format {

s=s.replace('''fn emit_json(row: &Row, out: &mut dyn Write) -> io::Result<()> {
    json::write_row(row, out)
}

''','')
open(p,'w').write(s)
p='crates/binloc-core/build.rs'; s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace('''    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");''','''    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=build.rs");
    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed={}", TABLE);''')
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
grep -n 'Row' crates/binloc/src/main.rs | head
